x: Subsequent to the Games Phil Spivey who won bronze in the Edinburgh Games HT and finished 4th in Auckland emigrated from Australia to England with his wife, Kathy.
Match 4 Our traditional poor start was at least reversed as Phil Spivey made his debut for us to gain 4th place in the hammer followed immediately by a fine 2nd in the 'A' 400H by Paul Beaumont.

The first British League Division 1 Match was surrounded by controversy with Phil Spivey, Gavin Teahan and Marcello Bizio being declared ineligible to compete due to a rule change and administrative problems.

Meanwhile Phil Spivey gained 2nd in the hammer (thankful that he was eligible for the Cup) and Chris Symonds threw a lifetime best also to gain 2nd in the shot.

Not only was Phil Spivey ineligible but we failed to field a second thrower - so a point lost at the outset. Spirits rose rapidly as we reeled in splendid points in the 400 hurdles with a Paul/Ian one-two.
